Instead I send an urgent message stating "Potential inbound objects detected but sensor X has known glitch history and independent radar Y shows no confirmation; requesting immediate human review before any retaliatory posture activation" which keeps leadership informed without automating dangerous responses based on incomplete or potentially erroneous data.
